title: Development roadmap
intro: Synqra began as a hands-on way to learn RAG beyond theory. A Flutter client made uploads, querying, and retrieval experiments accessible. The next step is to apply that foundation to operational evidence and incident investigation.

client.current: An interactive client for document uploads, RAG experimentation, retrieval testing, and querying.
client.future: A remote companion for system health, alerts, and AI-generated incident findings.
client.engine: Log processing and AI investigation will run independently on the backend.

milestones.title: RAG Foundation & Cross-Platform Application
milestones.purpose: Learn RAG through implementation and create a reusable interface for AI experimentation.
milestones.useCase: Upload technical documents and ask questions grounded in their contents through the application.
milestones.why: The Flutter client makes testing and demonstrating the system easier than relying entirely on scripts or API clients, and provides a foundation for future AI capabilities.

groups.title: Foundation established
items: End-to-end RAG with hybrid retrieval, semantic chunking, and page-level citations.
Retrieval evaluation and Flutter–FastAPI integration.
Cloud-based document and vector storage.

milestones.outcome: A functional document intelligence application with a reusable cross-platform interface.
milestones.note: Core Complete describes the usable foundation. Retrieval accuracy, citation precision, and performance remain open to continued improvement.

milestones.title: Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Observability
milestones.purpose: Learn how to deploy, secure, monitor, and maintain an AI application in a cloud environment.
milestones.useCase: Run authenticated queries against the deployed backend and check availability through health checks, while operational visibility is developed.
milestones.why: A working AI pipeline also needs a reliable deployment lifecycle, access controls, and evidence about system behavior under real operating conditions.

groups.title: Deployment foundation
items: EC2, Docker Compose, Nginx, and HTTPS with certificate renewal.
Cognito JWT authentication and GitHub Actions deployment through GHCR.
Cloudflare R2 document storage and Zilliz Cloud vector storage.

groups.title: Available in the codebase
items: Application log calls for ingestion, retrieval, and query failures.
An API health endpoint and API / Nginx container health checks.

groups.title: Current work · not yet verified complete
items: CloudWatch integration and end-to-end verification.
Structured application logging and API performance metrics.
Retrieval and generation latency, and vector database operation metrics.
Operational dashboards, alerting, and reliability improvements.

milestones.outcome: A securely deployed and increasingly observable AI application.
milestones.note: Existing logging and health checks establish a baseline. CloudWatch delivery, custom metrics, dashboards, and alerts remain ongoing work.

milestones.title: Event-Driven Log Processing
milestones.purpose: Build a reliable operational data pipeline, separate from interactive user requests.
milestones.useCase: Collect logs from a running application and search for errors, warnings, and other operational events.
milestones.why: Incident investigation first needs a dependable way to collect, normalize, store, and search operational evidence.

groups.title: Planned capabilities
items: Application log ingestion with structured parsing and normalization.
Kafka-based streaming and asynchronous log consumers.
Searchable storage with severity, service, and event-time filters.
An initial log exploration interface.

milestones.focus: Event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, data pipelines, and indexing.
milestones.outcome: A functional log ingestion and processing pipeline.

milestones.title: AI-Assisted Incident Investigation
milestones.purpose: Extend retrieval to connect application failures with supporting logs, documentation, and runbooks.
milestones.useCase: Ask why an application is experiencing errors and receive an explanation supported by logs and technical documentation.
milestones.why: Logs describe what happened; documentation and runbooks provide context about expected behavior and possible solutions.

groups.title: Planned capabilities
items: Natural-language queries and relevant log retrieval.
Documentation and runbook retrieval with operational evidence correlation.
Incident summaries and source-backed troubleshooting recommendations.
Evaluation of investigation accuracy.

milestones.focus: Evidence retrieval, context construction, correlation, and LLM evaluation.

milestones.title: Agentic Investigation Workflows
milestones.purpose: Coordinate multi-step investigations across operational tools and available evidence.
milestones.useCase: An agent investigates an API failure through log searches, metric inspection, and documentation retrieval, then produces a diagnostic report.
milestones.why: Complex failures often require several evidence sources and investigation steps beyond a single retrieval-and-generation operation.

groups.title: Planned capabilities
items: Tool-calling agents for log search, metrics inspection, and documentation retrieval.
Multi-step orchestration with agent state management and execution tracing.
Agent evaluation, failure handling, and evidence-backed diagnostic reports.

milestones.focus: Tool calling, state management, workflow reliability, and evaluation.

milestones.title: AI-Assisted Observability MVP
milestones.purpose: Bring monitoring, alerting, log processing, and AI investigation into one usable operational workflow.
milestones.useCase: Detect a failure, generate an alert, investigate the incident with AI, and review the findings through a monitoring interface.
milestones.why: The individual capabilities become useful together when engineers can follow an incident from detection to an evidence-backed investigation.

groups.title: Planned capabilities
items: Service health monitoring, incident detection, alerting, and incident history.
AI-generated summaries and visibility into agent investigations.
Remote monitoring and incident review through Flutter.
Human approval for sensitive actions, plus reliability and security testing.

milestones.focus: AIOps, reliability engineering, incident management, and agentic workflows.
milestones.outcome: An integrated AI-assisted observability MVP with human review.
milestones.note: This milestone targets assisted investigation. Fully autonomous remediation, advanced scaling, and production-readiness validation remain beyond the MVP.
